title: Completion records when a profile is revoked mid-flight
description: Accepted by opum-doc as an audit gap, not a security one (ODOC-488 / DEC-217 a1, opum-ai/ward-cli#149 review). An admitted run may finish, but writeAudit at completion still re-checks binding and approval, so a profile revoke landing mid-flight makes completion fail and the run report auditRecorded=false. ADR 0020 applies admitted-may-finish to grants only; completion should record against the admitted secret id and profile whatever happened to the approval since.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A profile revoke or binding change landing while a request is in flight still records the completion audit record and reports auditRecorded=true
A test revokes the profile in the transport hook and asserts both audit phases and that nothing further is sent
